headline: Earnings double-header tonight: our open Microsoft and T-Mobile 3-month calls both report after the bell, the Fed decides at 2 PM, and no Bold Bet because nothing on Wednesday's board cleared Max Edge's bar
top_call: Tonight is judgment night. Microsoft and T-Mobile, two of our three open 3-month calls, both report after the close, a few hours after the Fed's 2 PM decision. No new call today: we already made our bets, and we're grading them in public against the S&P 500.
backdrop: Nasdaq futures rose about 0.4% and S&P 500 futures 0.1% early Wednesday as SK Hynix's sevenfold profit jump lifted chip stocks, while Dow futures slipped about 0.2%. The Fed is expected to hold at 3.75%-4.00% at 2 PM ET; Microsoft, Alphabet and T-Mobile report after the close.

ai.headline: OpenAI plans to buy Google's TPU chips, moving from renting them to owning them, The Information reports
ai.why: Nvidia's biggest customer shopping for a second supplier is the clearest sign yet that TPUs are a real alternative.

ai.headline: Anthropic gives federal, state and local governments 40% off Claude, with no minimum spend, estimating $1B in savings
ai.why: Government is becoming a usage-priced AI customer, and about 500 agencies already run Claude.

ai.headline: The Netherlands plans to cut about 25,000 central-government jobs by 2035, leaning on AI to save €3.5 billion a year
ai.why: It's the most aggressive government plan yet to turn AI productivity into actual headcount cuts.

ai.headline: Google DeepMind unveils Genie 4, a real-time world model with more realistic physics, people and native audio
ai.why: Interactive simulated worlds are the training ground for robots and agents, and a new kind of game engine.

ai.headline: Cloudflare says a cache bug made its GLM-5.3 Workers AI model answer 155 requests with other customers' data
ai.why: Shared inference servers can leak between tenants, so 'who else is on my GPU' is now a real security question.

no_bets_note: Closest misses at 7:15 AM ET: Rays 41.5¢ vs the Brewers (+1.2 pts), Lakers 63.5¢ vs the Clippers (+1.0 pts), Maple Leafs 51.5¢ at Seattle (+0.7 pts). Every NBA, NHL and MLB game on the board priced within 1.2 points of DraftKings' no-vig line. DraftKings lines via ESPN.
